heroHeadline: 88 Areas Under Calamity as Philippine Disaster Cascade Deepens
heroSubtitle: M7.8 Mindanao earthquake and tsunami, Typhoon Bavi's landslides, and the Luis-Maymay-Neneng-Dolphin-Kujira storm sequence have killed 158+ and affected 6.5 million+, with 88 cities and municipalities — including four entire provinces — now under a state of calamity
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
